request
received”. The task “assess
risk” is performed, after which the flow proceeds to “an unnamed exclusiveGateway”. At the exclusive (XOR) gateway “an unnamed exclusiveGateway” the flow branches to “carry out
a simple
risk assessment” when risk is below a threshold; to “carry out an
advanced
risk assessment” when risk is above a threshold. The task “carry out
a simple
risk assessment” is performed, after which the flow proceeds to “an unnamed exclusiveGateway”. The task “carry out an
advanced
risk assessment” is performed, after which the flow proceeds to “an unnamed exclusiveGateway”. The exclusive (XOR) gateway “an unnamed exclusiveGateway” merges the incoming paths and continues to “an unnamed parallelGateway”. At the parallel (AND) gateway “an unnamed parallelGateway” the flow branches to “organize
disbursement”; to “notify
costumer
with the
result of
the assessment”. The task “organize
disbursement” is performed, after which the flow proceeds to “an unnamed parallelGateway”. The task “notify
costumer
with the
result of
the assessment” is performed, after which the flow proceeds to “an unnamed parallelGateway”. The parallel (AND) gateway “an unnamed parallelGateway” merges the incoming paths and continues to “credit
card
request
accepted”. The process concludes at the end event “credit
card
request
accepted”.
